title: Use AI Better Than 99% of People

viewer.who: Knowledge workers and creators who use AI chat daily
viewer.problem: They use AI like a search box and get shallow, generic answers
viewer.job: Direct AI like a colleague: context, delegation, correction, background monitoring, workflows

idea: Animated conceptual explainer, adapted from the reference video's method: stop prompting AI like Google; give it context, delegate whole tasks, correct mistakes, let it monitor, and build workflows.

claims.text: Most people use AI like a search engine — isolated questions, shallow generic answers — which barely scratches the surface.
Highly effective users treat AI like a capable colleague: they give it context, delegate complete tasks, correct its mistakes, and let it monitor things in the background.
Instead of asking more questions, effective users build workflows that get work done; the closing advice is to stop just prompting AI and start directing it.
This Short is an illustrated conceptual explainer with AI-generated narration; every interface shown is drawn concept artwork, not a real product demonstration.

proof_plan.how_shown: Hook scene: animated chat with typed questions and generic-answer cards flying off; slammed headline 'YOU'RE USING AI WRONG.' Method framing from the reference video, presented as editorial method, not measured fact.

Four consecutive animated conceptual scenes — knowledge-base documents assembling (context), an agent progressing a task through research/plan/execute (delegation), a wrong figure flagged and corrected (correction), a radar watcher firing a notification (monitoring) — each labelled 'CONCEPTUAL WORKFLOW' on screen.
Three workflow lanes complete and converge into one composition, closing with 'STOP PROMPTING. START DIRECTING.' typography synced to the narration.
All interfaces are drawn illustrations carrying a 'CONCEPTUAL WORKFLOW' tag; post copy discloses AI-generated narration and conceptual illustration.
